prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: PRODUCTION BACKGROUND PAINTING for a portrait daily game. Generate one new original scene, a single full-bleed 2:3 PORTRAIT image, 1024 pixels wide by 1536 pixels high. Reference image 1 is an approved six-panel concept board: use ONLY the designated panel's environment, atmosphere, and warm realistic gouache / colored-pencil travel-postcard style, NEVER its glass, labels, borders, or board layout. Reference images 2 and 3 show the game's empty-table composition and richly painted natural materials. These are style and composition REFERENCES, not edit targets. Create new art; do not crop, collage, or reproduce a board panel.

MANDATORY COMPOSITION: The bottom 40% of the image is ONE wholly EMPTY warm wood tabletop spanning the entire image width. The straight, perfectly horizontal REAR EDGE of this tabletop lies at exactly 60% of the image height (y approximately 920 of 1536), from left edge to right edge. All the wood from y=920 through bottom is clear, uninterrupted table surface, carefully painted grain and subtle reflections only. No table legs visible. Table seen naturally from slightly above; believable perspective. Center 30%-70% width is clear for a separately rendered game vessel. The upper 60% holds the gathering and architecture, with small adult friends well behind the foreground table; no close-up portrait, no people leaning onto the foreground table. Table height and framing are crucial game geometry.

ALL SCENES must include a clearly visible decorated Christmas tree with glowing lights and red/gold ornaments, AND strings of holiday lights across architecture or overhead. Warm inviting realistic painted gouache with subtle colored-pencil surface texture; rich tactile natural materials and convincing depth; not a photograph, not vector art, not a loose abstract sketch. Follow the approved postcard aesthetic.

ABSOLUTE EXCLUSIONS: NO foreground glass, NO cup, NO mug, NO chalice, NO drink, NO bottle, NO vessel of any kind on or above the foreground table. No plates, coasters, candles, ribbons, greenery, confetti, presents or other objects on the foreground table. No branding, logos, writing, labels, watermark, typography, letters, captions, game UI, borders, frames or collage. No extra panels. Keep every item and decoration BEHIND the clear table.

Scene: Reinterpret the BOTTOM-MIDDLE warm-climate Christmas environment of the board. A snow-free adobe courtyard at warm sunset edging into violet twilight, distant rugged desert mountains visible through a stucco arch. Terracotta walls, a few citrus branches with oranges at upper left, delicate glowing paper star lanterns and strings of warm Christmas bulbs overhead. A small fully decorated Christmas tree with red-and-gold ornaments and glowing lights stands beside the stucco arch. A low fire bowl with a modest glowing flame is far behind the foreground table, with a small group of adult friends in light sweaters chatting beyond it. Terracotta, soft sunset rose, dusk violet, evergreen and cranberry. No snow anywhere. Detailed stucco and wood, believable perspective. Mandatory completely empty broad wooden table spanning the lower 40%, straight rear edge at 60% image height; all fire, plants, people and decoration remain well behind that rear edge.

tabletopMeasurement.method: Visual inspection of generated image at native resolution; horizontal rear table boundary.

notes: Snow-free adobe courtyard with paper stars, warm sunset and distant desert mountains.
